task: Remove Fast Debug source-fingerprint fallback lookup while retaining checked function result evaluation.
observation: Deleting the handle scan exposed that function result evaluation had relied on source matching instead of requesting its checked ReturnValue slot. The internal invariant identified the exact missing context; passing the slot restored the generic string fixture without restoring text lookup.
impact: The fallback removal could be completed with a narrow checked-context handoff and the fixture now exercises fail-closed behavior in both default and shadow modes.

resolution.summary: Function and method result evaluation now passes ExprSlot::ReturnValue to expression_tree, and pipeline resolution receives the active tree node directly.

task: Diagnose checker hangs exposed by the C1 full-suite gate while Fast Debug expression text lookup was removed.
observation: The first C1 gate exposed stack overflows in specialized function return inference and pipeline inference. AddressSanitizer identified re-entry through inferred_expr_core and inferred_functional_pipeline_state. A separate grouped recovery probe stalled only after local-call collection began pushing checked cursors into the shared inference cursor stack; restoring the prior collector recursion preserved the checker result.
impact: Targeted guards and a narrow collector rollback restored the expected diagnostics and grouped recovery behavior without changing accepted programs; checker parser/cache counts are outside the re-scoped target.

resolution.summary: Guard recursive specialized-return and functional-pipeline inference; require the active pipeline cursor source to match; restore the pre-cursor local-call collector. Focused EST harnesses pass; make check must be rerun at the C1 gate.
